description: The line plot, titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset," illustrates the performance of different model variants on a classification metric, with the y-axis labeled "Metric (%)" ranging from 58 to 66. The x-axis displays five distinct model configurations: "Full model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," "w/o Attention," and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The legend indicates that the purple line represents the "Recall" metric, the blue line represents the "Recall" metric, and the brown line represents the "F1-score" metric. The "Full model (Ours)" achieves the highest metric values, with a recall of 65.78% and an F1-score of 65.45%. When the prompt is removed ("w/o Prompt"), both metrics drop significantly, with recall at 59.64% and F1-score at 60.16%. The "w/o Augmentation" variant shows a recovery in performance, with recall reaching 62.63% and F1-score at 62.22%. The "w/o Attention" variant results in a decline, with recall at 59.17% and F1-score at 59.67%. Finally, the "w/o Prompt & Augmentation" variant shows the lowest performance, with recall at 56.82% and F1-score at 57.74%. The plot demonstrates that the full model performs best, and the removal of components generally leads to a decrease in performance, with augmentation having a particularly strong positive impact.
